newsitem.title: USA: Hartford Life set to raise around $600 mln in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Hartford Life set to raise around $600 mln in IPO.

text.p: Hartford Life is set to offer 23 million shares at a price range of $24 to $27 a share, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
This gives the deal a value between $552 million and $621 million.
The company, a subsidiary of insurance giant ITT Hartford Group Inc, is tentatively scheduled to make its debut on the New York Stock Exchange around May 21, said lead underwriter Goldman Sachs.
Of the 23 million shares on offer, 18.4 million are slated for the United States and 4.6 million are being sold in a concurrent international offering.
